items.title: Understand
items.text: Why tax withheld every month is worked out again at year end

items.title: **Work it out**
items.text: One worked example, from a year's income to the refund

items.title: File it
items.text: Whether you need to, and when and where to do it

components.text: The people and figures in the examples are made up. Every rule cites its source at the foot of the page

notes: Three things tonight. First, understand why your employer withholds tax every month and the year still has to be recalculated. Second, calculate: one worked example, line by line, from income to refund. Third, file: do you need to, when, and where. Halfway through you get three practice problems, so have a pen or your phone's calculator ready.
